questions.q: Why are the people standing in the rain?
questions.e: In the video: "kako bi skupili novac za lečenje njene sestre" — to raise money for her sister's treatment.
In the video: "Ima multiplu sklerozu već pet godina" — she has had multiple sclerosis for five years.

questions.q: How many children does she have?
questions.e: In the video: "Ima troje dece" — she has three children.

questions.q: How many dinars are in the gift?
questions.e: In the video: "Unutra ima 50.000 dinara" — there are 50,000 dinars inside.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ovi ljudi stoje po kiši kako bi skupili novac za *lečenje* njene sestre.
Ima troje *dece*, najmlađe ima četiri godine.
questions.e: Deca — children; troje dece — three children.

questions.q: A mi idemo da ih *iznenadimo* malim poklonom.

questions.e: Po + locative: po kiši — in the rain.

questions.q: A mi idemo da ih iznenadimo malim ___
Ima ___ dece, najmlađe ima četiri godine.
questions.e: For children, the collective numeral: troje dece.

questions.q: Hajde zajedno da pomognemo mama Aleksandri da se ___ što pre kući
questions.e: da + present: da se vrati — so that she returns.
